models.title: Reading · Hamilton, from a hurricane to Broadway

block.label: READING · FROM A HURRICANE TO BROADWAY
block.html:
Alexander Hamilton was born on Nevis, a small island in the Caribbean, in the 1750s. His family was very poor. His father left, and his mother died when he was a child. Alexander was an orphan, but he was very smart and he loved to write.

When he was a teenager, he was living on the island of St. Croix. In 1772, a terrible hurricane hit the island. Alexander wrote a long letter about the storm, and a newspaper published it. People were so impressed that they collected money and sent him to study in New York.

In America, Hamilton was very ambitious. He fought in the war against the British, he worked for George Washington, and later he became the first Secretary of the Treasury: he created the country's financial system. Today his face is on the ten-dollar bill. But he also had enemies. In 1804, his rival Aaron Burr challenged him to a duel, and Hamilton died the next day.

More than two hundred years later, a young writer, Lin-Manuel Miranda, was on vacation when he started reading a biography of Hamilton. He thought it was the perfect story for a hip-hop musical, and he spent several years writing it. Hamilton opened on Broadway in 2015. The tickets sold out for months, and the show won 11 Tony Awards. On stage, actors from many different backgrounds play the founding fathers of the United States, and they rap, sing and battle like in a hip-hop show.

block.label: TRUE OR FALSE?
block.html: Then correct the false sentences out loud.

items.before: Hamilton was born in New York.

block.label: GAME · THE BATTLE
block.html:
In Hamilton, politicians have "cabinet battles": they fight with words! Draw a topic and a side. One person speaks for one minute, then the partner answers for the other side. The teacher decides the winner!
Useful: In my opinion… · First of all… · And another thing is… · That's not true, because…
lines: Summer is better than winter.
Living in a big city is better than living in a small town.
Cinema is better than Netflix.
Dogs are better than cats.
Working from home is better than working at the office.
Brazilian food is the best in the world.
Teenagers should not have phones.
Money is more important than free time.

block.label: ROLE-PLAY · HAMILTON IS HERE!
block.html: Alexander Hamilton traveled in time to 2026! One of you is a TV reporter, the other is Hamilton. Then change roles.

roles.name: TV reporter
roles.card: Ask about his life in the past: Where were you born? What happened in 1772? What did you do in New York? Who was your enemy? Then ask about today: What do you think of 2026? Did you see the musical about you? What surprised you the most?

roles.name: Alexander Hamilton
roles.card: Answer with details, in the past simple. You are proud and a little dramatic! Today, everything surprises you: phones, airplanes, your face on the money, rap music. Ask the reporter one question about 2026, too.
